source_decisions.title: PSASB Year 2 cash-to-accrual e-learning: IPSAS 12 inventories and noncurrent assets
source_decisions.evidence: PSASB 19 February 2026 announcement states Year 2 Part 1 inventory IPSAS 12 and Part 2 IPSAS 27,31,43,45. Live official portal lists 14 lectures Part 1 and 43 Part 2; course content requires enrollment. Portal copyright 2026 all rights reserved; Terms & Conditions link returns 404. Neither lectures nor worked questions accessed.
source_decisions.quality: Authoritative current Kenyan public-sector professional course access; contents and worked solutions unreviewed; registration gated; not KASNEB curriculum certification.
source_decisions.trigger: PSASB course update, access terms restored, IPSAS transition change, exact permission grant
source_decisions.constraint: Course pages are not commercial downloadable teaching assets; no copying videos, quizzes or screenshots.

source_decisions.title: PSASB FY2025/26 annual public-sector financial reporting templates index
source_decisions.evidence: PSASB 3 August 2026 announcement reports FY2025/26 revised templates and 15 June 2026 Treasury direction. Official live index links MDA, county, state corporation and other FY2025/26 templates; individual MDA DOCX link could not be parsed by web reader; no template contents/embedded third-party rights or macro/payload inspection completed.
source_decisions.quality: Current authoritative template discovery, not worked practice or validated template binary; 2024/25 and 2025/26 files coexist so exact FY matters.
source_decisions.trigger: FY2026/27 replacement, correction, new template edition, licence grant, source terms change
source_decisions.constraint: Do not download/host DOCX for distribution without full content, macro/payload and rights review.

source_decisions.title: ODPC FAQ page — inconsistent answer to 'Who is a Data Processor?'
source_decisions.evidence: Official ODPC FAQ currently pairs the heading 'Who is a Data Processor?' with generic contact information rather than a definition. The separate ODPC compliance page defines processor as acting on behalf of controller. This is a selected-page accuracy defect, not evidence that all ODPC guidance is unreliable.
source_decisions.quality: Do not use faulty FAQ answer as a teaching definition. Keep source as a flagged link for provenance and request correction/recheck.
source_decisions.trigger: ODPC FAQ correction or authoritative updated definition
source_decisions.constraint: No commercial copying or fulltext; existing separately reviewed ODPC DPIA guidance remains unaffected.
